note: On the Kancamagus Highway 12 miles west of Conway, with the Swift River behind the campground and a short trail to the Russell-Colbath Historic Site. --Claude
summary: FS page + site map: 75 sites, all first-come (no rec.gov listing), $30 + $6 extra vehicle, coin showers $3, flush toilets, water, mid-May to mid-October. No rig-length source found. Not waterfront stays.
flags: Rig length: no source gives site lengths (no rec.gov catalog; the FS page is silent). The stored claim that sites 1-9 are tent-only and that large sites take most rigs came from the old note and is dropped from it unverified; the site map draws 1-9 and most sites as plain spurs (squares and circles, no legend). max_rig_ft stays unknown.

Waterfront: not waterfront stays. The site map shows the Swift River beyond the north-east loop (sites 45-54 nearest); Esri 43.9995,-71.3335 shows continuous canopy over the whole campground with the river (~20-25 m wide, gravel bars) at its edge - creekside width at most and under canopy.
Phone 603-536-6100 (WMNF Supervisor's Office, FS page footer) kept; no concessionaire number on a rec.gov listing because there is none. Website unchanged.
Pin 43.99788,-71.33393 = FS lat/long (entrance side by the highway); the loops are under canopy so their centroid cannot be measured; no move proposed.
Note rewritten: the old one repeated sites, hookups, facilities and season.
